grammar.summary: 本课巩固 which 的选择用法，并学习 one/ones 的单复数替代。

points.title: ones 复数替代
points.explanation: one 替代单数、ones 替代复数：Which glasses? The ones on the shelf.（哪些杯子？架子上的那些。）

examples.en: These glasses? No, not those. The ones on the television.
examples.cn: 这些杯子吗？不，不是那些。电视机上的那些。

exercises.q: Give Tim this shirt. Give ___ this one, too.
Give Jane this watch. Give ___ this one, too.
Give the children these ice creams. Give ___ these, too.
Give Tom this book. Give ___ this one, too.
That is my passport. Give ___ my passport please.
That is my coat. Give ___ my coat please.
Those are our umbrellas. Give ___ our umbrellas please.
